name: Resurf

#10 card and divider borders ~#000 @8% (~1.1:1) fall well under the 3:1 non-text floor
native#3 split selection grammar: sidebar = neutral grey inset fill, content card = system-blue ring
native#6 partial: functional accent (blue) consistent, but the sidebar-grey vs content-blue selection split undercuts accent binding

content-card selection ring; matches kit Blue-light #0088FF (specified)
Beta pill + Assistant sparkle only; jewelry, never a CTA
NOT accent-tinted; radius matches kit sidebar-selection 8 (specified)

tokens.value: flat opaque, borderless mono SF Symbols, ~40-52pt tall
tokens.notes: no glass material, no scroll-edge effect visible
headline only; app UI carries no serif

patterns.key_values: ~200pt source list, flat rows leading mono SF Symbol + label, sentence-case collapsible section headers (Triage/Library/Areas) with disclosure chevrons, right-aligned count badges, neutral-grey inset-rounded selection (radius ~8), per-area pastel identity icons
leading nav cluster (back/forward/sidebar-toggle) + breadcrumb path 'Library > All', trailing borderless +/sparkle/overflow; flat opaque, no glass
masonry variable-height preview cards, ~12pt radius, ~1px @8% border, footer = type-icon + title; one card selected via blue ring
right-side opt-in Assistant panel, header sparkle + title + Beta pill + history/+/filled-circle-close, body = bold pull-quote then bold-lead-in bullet list
in-content search/filter row: capsule search field with removable 'Recent x' token + placeholder, four trailing view-controls (filter/focus/sort/grid)

signature_moves: Masonry visual-library card wall as the primary content surface — web/Pinterest pattern borrowed deliberately for a heterogeneous visual everything-bucket (systematic + purposeful = signature, not defect)
AI 'Assistant' copilot lodged in the native inspector slot rather than a modal, with its own reserved pink Beta identity
Two-hue accent discipline: system blue = all functional selection/focus; a single pink = AI/Beta identity only, used as jewelry; per-area muted-pastel identity icons kept separate
Serif brand / sans app split — editorial serif display lives only in marketing; the app is disciplined all-SF-Pro
defects: Split selection grammar (native-tell #3) — sidebar neutral-grey inset fill vs content system-blue ring; canon wants one accent-bound selection language
Contrast Dilution — card/divider borders ~1.1:1 (under 3:1) and faint Areas labels near the 4.5:1 text floor; soft aesthetic bought partly with legibility
Minor UIKit tell — filled-circle close button on the Assistant panel

aesthetic.direction: restrained neutral product-UI (near-white grounds, soft radii, one electric accent) with an editorial-serif brand layer bolted on outside the window

psychology: Jakob's Law — three-pane sidebar/content/inspector plus a Pinterest-style card wall means users arrive already knowing how to drive it; near-zero learning cost
Hick's Law / chunking (Miller-Cowan) — navigation chunked into three labeled collapsible groups (Triage/Library/Areas) keeps each decision point small
Von Restorff / signal-detection — the lone blue selection ring and the single pink Beta pill are the only saturated marks, so attention lands exactly where intended
Progressive disclosure — collapsible sidebar sections and an opt-in Assistant inspector keep the default view quiet

Aesthetic-usability effect (with its limit) — high spatial polish buys perceived usability, but the sub-3:1 borders and faint tertiary labels are where the halo starts writing checks legibility can't cash
notes: Single surface, and it is a MARKETING COMPOSITE: serif headline + sans subhead on a warm-grey backdrop above the window, plus a floating white 'Resurf' brand pill composited over the grid (both excluded from app evidence). The window is scaled for the composite (traffic-light cluster ~56px against a ~2085px window — neither clean @1x nor @2x), so absolute pt values are estimated with a scale caveat; ratios/proportions are the trustworthy readings. Lineage reads native (13pt-class body, ~24pt rows, genuine coloured traffic-lights, sentence-case collapsible source-list headers, borderless SF-Symbol toolbar, breadcrumb path) but confidence is only medium: the masonry grid and a filled-circle close button carry web/UIKit flavor, and 'local-first mac app' marketing copy doesn't prove the toolkit (could be polished SwiftUI or a native-styled Tauri/Electron build). Era marked liquid-glass for the 2026 capsule-bezel language, but NO Liquid Glass material is shown — chrome is flat opaque, so glass-discipline audit items are N/A (legitimate absence), and the look would read equally as late Big-Sur. The icon.webp (a soft 3D isometric cube, calm premium utility) was noted as brand context only — not digested (Workflow A / UI only).
